Proposition4.3 has a conditional periodic-orbit repair for the selected strong simulator. A smooth mapping-torus adapted metric gives an affirmative finite-energy steady example for the stated arbitrary-metric Hodge-viscosity openproblem. Bernoulli and planar coordinate formulas need local correction.
